page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. The strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Hinc itaq; manifestum est quòd etiam instrumenta Satanæ, pseudoprophetæ, pseudochristi, & pseudodoctores interdum edant vera miracula. Itaq; non necessariò demonstrant veram ecclesiam & veros Christi servos.

Deinde sæpius deprehensum est, miracula Romanensium esse meras præstigias: si quæ autem videantur illorum esse miracula, speciem seu apparentiam tantùm habent, at vel formâ seu differentia miraculorum verâ destituuntur. Ea autem est modus omnem vim creatam excedens,& finis quoq;, qui divinis & proprie dictis miraculis est propositus, ab illis operibus abest, non enim fiunt virtute supernaturali, sed aut sunt dæmoniorũ fallacię, aut opera naturalib. causis pdu-cta[?], at pierisq; occulta eorum producendorum ratio: & ad mendacé doctrinam stabiliendam referuntur.

page.notes: The first line "næ ejusque mancipiis habenas." is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "deprehensum est" is joined across the line end; the printed mark there is ambiguous and is read as a space. "pdu-cta" is the printed abbreviated form of producta, read uncertainly. Its line-end hyphen is kept as printed. The catchword "De-" and the signature "O 4" sit at the foot.
